purpose: Operationalize Representation Contract as a mandatory pre-verdict gate for any JANUS similarity, difference, anomaly, cross-witness, or comparative claim.
canonical_pipeline: CLAIM(I) -> REPRESENTATION_CONTRACT(I,R) -> METRIC -> CONTROL -> TEST -> VERDICT
mandatory_precondition: Before computing or interpreting delta_R(X1,X2), JANUS must establish that representation R preserves sufficient information about target invariant I.

exploratory_rule.constraint: JANUS may measure or inspect patterns without a valid contract, but may not convert those measurements into claims about invariant I until a valid Representation Contract is established.

control_rule: CONTROL MUST HAVE POWER TO SAY NO
interpretive_rights_rule: delta_R(X1,X2) may support a claim about I only when R preserves sufficient information about I and the frozen metric/reference/control/falsifier contract passes.
